title: Judgments on Neighbors

questions.question: Who was Amos among the shepherds of?
questions.explanation: Amos 1:1 (ESV): "The words of Amos, who was among the shepherds of Tekoa..."

questions.question: The Lord roars from Zion and utters his voice from where?
questions.explanation: Amos 1:2 (ESV): "The Lord roars from Zion and utters his voice from Jerusalem;"

questions.question: For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not revoke the punishment, because they have threshed Gilead with threshing sledges of what?
questions.explanation: Amos 1:3 (ESV): "because they have threshed Gilead with threshing sledges of iron."

questions.question: I will send a fire upon the house of Hazael, and it shall devour the strongholds of whom?
questions.explanation: Amos 1:4 (ESV): "and it shall devour the strongholds of Ben-hadad."

questions.question: The people of Syria shall go into exile to where?
questions.explanation: Amos 1:5 (ESV): "and the people of Syria shall go into exile to Kir,"

questions.question: Gaza is punished because they carried into exile a whole people to deliver them up to whom?
questions.explanation: Amos 1:6 (ESV): "because they carried into exile a whole people to deliver them up to Edom."

questions.question: I will cut off the inhabitants from Ashdod, and him who holds the scepter from where?
questions.explanation: Amos 1:8 (ESV): "I will cut off the inhabitants from Ashdod, and him who holds the scepter from Ashkelon;"

questions.question: Tyre is punished because they delivered up a whole people to Edom, and did not remember the covenant of what?
questions.explanation: Amos 1:9 (ESV): "and did not remember the covenant of brotherhood."

questions.question: Edom is punished because he pursued his brother with the sword and cast off all what?
questions.explanation: Amos 1:11 (ESV): "because he pursued his brother with the sword and cast off all pity,"

questions.question: Ammon is punished because they have ripped open pregnant women in Gilead, that they might enlarge their what?
questions.explanation: Amos 1:13 (ESV): "that they might enlarge their border."

questions.question: In the days of which kings did Amos prophesy?
options: Uzziah king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Joash king of Israel
Hezekiah king of Judah and Hoshea king of Israel
Josiah king of Judah and Pekah king of Israel
David king of Judah and Solomon king of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Uzziah king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Joash king of Israel
questions.explanation: Amos 1:1 (ESV): "in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel,"

questions.question: How long before the earthquake did Amos see these words?
I will break the gate-bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitants from where?
questions.explanation: Amos 1:5 (ESV): "I will break the gate-bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitants from the Valley of Aven,"

questions.question: To where will I send a fire that shall devour the strongholds of Gaza?
questions.explanation: Amos 1:7 (ESV): "So I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza,"

questions.question: Who shall perish, according to the prophecy against Philistia?
questions.explanation: Amos 1:8 (ESV): "and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish,"

key_verse_text: And he said: "The Lord roars from Zion and utters his voice from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds mourn, and the top of Carmel withers."
